purpose: Compare project classifier output with verified local control conditions and direct protocol observations.
transport_scope: loopback only; no external endpoints or DNS

cases.condition: ECH explicitly disabled against the local ECH server
Client receives a freshly generated, syntactically valid ECHConfigList with a new HPKE key; server retains the existing local ECH private key/config
cases.score_scope: server rejection and retry event only; root-cause taxonomy is not represented
evidence_requirements: client and server config hashes differ

cases.condition: ECH disabled; connect to loopback using wrong.localhost while validating the existing certificate for public.localhost
cases.score_scope: independent TLS failure category; certificate hostname mismatch independently verified
evidence_requirements: requested hostname absent from certificate SAN

cases.condition: Connect to a loopback port held bound but not listening by the runner
cases.score_scope: transport failure category; local socket state and curl refusal independently verified
evidence_requirements: loopback socket bound and not listening during attempt

cases.condition: Pass the exact fixed invalid ECHConfigList ecl:AA== to curl
cases.score_scope: correct abstention; schema has no client-config-parse-error class
evidence_requirements: curl reports ECH config parse/setup error
